svg.title: Four Core Seats; Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-core-six-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats; Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 2 FT + 2 C (4 people). Scaled: 3 FT + 3 C (6 people).; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each of the first four entries has numeric value 1 and represents one active core person: two full-time operators and two contractors. The final two entries have numeric value 0 because they are inactive in the core configuration; activating one FT and one C produces the six-person Scaled pod. Contractors are people, not full-time-equivalent claims. External vendor and trade sub-crews are charged to direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not counted as internal pod seats.; caption: The acquisition lead owns capital allocation; the general manager combines operating, service, and retention leadership. Two specialist contractors cover legal and financial workstreams. Add an operations lead and a systems contractor only at scale: four active core seats plus two optional seats, not six core hires.; stages: label: Acquisition lead; value: Core FT 1 of 2; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own purchase discipline, lender relationships, investment decisions, seller negotiations, and the weekly review of liquidity and customer concentration.; label: General manager; value: Core FT 2 of 2; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own the operating result, scheduling, vendor coordination, service standards, customer retention, and execution of the post-close 100-day integration plan. Retain delivery accountability when external vendors perform customer work.; label: Transaction counsel; value: Core contractor 1 of 2; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review transaction disclosures, purchase terms, lien releases, license transfers, employment issues, and post-close claims within a defined engagement.; label: Fractional controller, QoE and tax specialist; value: Core contractor 2 of 2; numeric value: 1.0; detail: One appropriately qualified contractor combines earnings verification, working-capital review, and tax-allocation support with post-close reconciliations, cash forecasting, receivables oversight, and covenant reporting. Define scope and capacity explicitly rather than implying extra seats.; label: Operations lead; value: Scale-only addition: FT 3 of 3; inactive in core; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Activate one additional full-time person only in the six-person Scaled configuration to own scheduling, vendor capacity, backlog, and service-quality controls, freeing the general manager for broader operating oversight.; label: Systems and workflow specialist; value: Scale-only addition: contractor 3 of 3; inactive in core; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Activate one additional contractor only in the Scaled configuration to configure accounting integrations, access controls, backups, and reporting automation; document recovery procedures and exception ownership.

text.title: Fractional controller, QoE and tax specialist

One appropriately qualified contractor combines earnings verification, working-capital review, and tax-allocation support with post-close reconciliations, cash forecasting, receivables oversight, and covenant reporting. Define scope and capacity explicitly rather than implying extra seats.
